steps.en: Get a Zep Cloud API key and install the SDK
steps.zh: 拿到 Zep Cloud 的 API 密钥，装上 SDK

steps.en: Register the user and open a thread for the conversation
steps.zh: 登记用户，为这段对话开一个 thread

steps.en: Send each message as the conversation happens
steps.zh: 对话进行中，每条消息都发过去

steps.en: Builds the user's temporal graph and retires facts that were superseded
steps.zh: 构建该用户的时序图谱，让被取代的事实失效

steps.en: Before the agent replies, ask for this thread's context
steps.zh: 智能体回复前，要这段对话的上下文

steps.en: Returns a ready-to-paste block of the relevant current facts
steps.zh: 返回一段可直接放进提示词的相关事实

value.en: Cross-session memory that drops outdated facts, with no graph database or extraction workers to run
value.zh: 跨会话记忆会自动丢掉过时事实，而你不用运行图数据库或抽取 worker

sources: https://github.com/getzep/zep README (not Zep's product; zep-cloud SDKs; integrations/; Community Edition deprecated, moved to legacy/)
https://github.com/getzep/graphiti README 'Graphiti and Zep' (Zep powered by Graphiti on a proprietary Context Graph Engine)
